SmoothCamAPI.h is copied unmodified from SmoothCam Beta1.8.1 source
`e0afd09aff26e5849dac461252e5bffbd5b69d62`, by mwilsnd and contributors:
https://github.com/mwilsnd/SkyrimSE-SmoothCam/blob/e0afd09aff26e5849dac461252e5bffbd5b69d62/SmoothCam/include/SmoothCamAPI.h

The header explicitly permits modders to copy it for API consumption. That
permission covers this header; no broader SmoothCam source/binary grant is
inferred. Its original permission/comments are preserved. SkyCRPG's MIT
license applies to original module source, not this external header.

TrueDirectionalMovementAPI.h is from TrueDirectionalMovement 2.3.1 source
`57b913ae17fed857c9e281799174898cd66a3e82`, by Ersh and contributors:
https://github.com/ersh1/TrueDirectionalMovement/blob/57b913ae17fed857c9e281799174898cd66a3e82/src/TrueDirectionalMovementAPI.h
Its explicit API-consumer copying permission is retained. The sole modification
uses GetModuleHandleW with a wide literal for this module's UNICODE build.
Upstream COPYING and EXCEPTIONS accompany this API declaration header as
TDM-COPYING and TDM-EXCEPTIONS. No TDM implementation/binary/art is included.
